title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.19564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent memory can personalize an LLM agent, but an incorrect durable update can silently distort future behavior. We study the memory-clarification boundary: whether interaction-derived information should be persisted, used only in the current context, re-verified, or clarified with the user. MCB contains 140 primary scenarios, split into 70 development and 70 held-out items, plus a separate 70-item contrast set. It evaluates both action labels and structured tool-call selection. Two non-authors independently label the 70 held-out primary and 70 contrast items (97.1% agreement, Cohen's kappa = 0.962); a blind third resolves four disagreements, replacing eight author labels by non-author majority. Across Claude and Qwen, models verify changing facts more reliably than they ask users to resolve ambiguity. Bare Qwen asks on 0/12 clarification items while verifying 12/18 freshness items. Few-shot prompting raises accuracy from 0.557 to 0

translated_title: 记住、验证还是询问？LLM智能代理中记忆承诺的跨家族评估
translated_abstract: 持久记忆可以使LLM智能代理个性化，但不正确的持久更新可能会悄然扭曲未来行为。我们研究了记忆-澄清边界：交互中获得的信息应被持久化、仅用于当前上下文、重新验证，还是向用户澄清。MCB包含140个主要场景，分为70个开发项目和70个保留项目，外加一个单独的70项对比集。它评估了动作标签和结构化工具调用选择。两位非作者独立标注了70个保留主要项目和70个对比项目（一致性97.1%，Cohen's kappa = 0.962）；一位盲评第三方解决了四个分歧，用非作者多数票替换了八个作者标签。在Claude和Qwen中，模型验证变化事实比询问用户解决歧义更可靠。裸Qwen在12个澄清项目中询问了0个，同时验证了18个新鲜度项目中的12个。少样本提示将准确率从0.557提升至0。
tldr: 该论文提出了MCB基准，评估LLM智能代理在记忆承诺中的决策边界，发现模型更擅长验证变化事实而非向用户询问歧义，且少样本提示能显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the MCB benchmark to evaluate memory commitment boundaries in LLM agents, finding that models verify changing facts more reliably than asking users to resolve ambiguity, with few-shot prompting significantly improving performance.
